svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 600 of 50 mm tubular webbing with a hot knife so the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends are sealed. Mark its middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Feed the chain's adjustable end through it before the master

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: link is fitted, and slide it to the middle of the loop.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It lies on the bark at the back of the trunk, opposite the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: frame, where the chain presses hardest.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On a 200 trunk it covers almost the whole loop; on bigger

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: trunks the chain each side of it is bare.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Replace it when it is cut through to the chain.
